output.title: Cancer pathway brief: South Ostrobothnia wellbeing services county

claims.text: In 2021-2025, age-standardised cancer mortality in South Ostrobothnia wellbeing services county was 4.8% above the national level (ratio 1.048, 95% interval 1.012-1.085), about 24.6 more deaths a year than its age structure predicts.

sources.label: Statistics Finland: causes of death 13u5 and 11az, population 14wx

facts.measure: age-standardised cancer mortality ratio, county relative to Finland (1 = national level)

claims.text: Referrals for specialised health care received processed within 3 days, % of referrals received: South Ostrobothnia wellbeing services county is at 70.8 (three-year mean to 2025) against 76.8 nationally.

sources.label: THL Sotkanet: Erikoissairaanhoitoon saapuneet 3 vrk:ssa käsitellyt lähetteet, % saapuneista lähetteistä

facts.indicator: Referrals for specialised health care received processed within 3 days, % of referrals received

claims.text: Among the stages that public data can measure, the earliest one where South Ostrobothnia wellbeing services county is clearly worse than the country is referral into specialist care.

pathway_stages_measurable_from_public_da: first contact and primary care access

claims.text: Time from referral to diagnosis and from diagnosis to first treatment is not published by county for any cancer, so the Goal 3 indicator "patients access treatment within the established target times" cannot be checked from open data.

statistics_not_published_by_county_for_a: time from diagnosis to first treatment
facts.goal_3_indicator_that_therefore_cannot_b: patients access treatment within the established target times

claims.text: Recommended: standardised, timed cancer pathways with a fast-track referral. Under the stated assumptions this postpones about 9.4 deaths a year in South Ostrobothnia wellbeing services county (range 1.4-18.9) for an assumed EUR 284,211 a year; it stayed in the portfolio in 94% of sensitivity runs.

facts.recommended_action: Standardised, timed cancer pathways with a fast-track referral
facts.nature_of_estimate: model scenario under stated assumptions, not a measured effect

claims.text: Proportion of invited to colorectal cancer screening who attended, %: 75.6% against the 80% target. Reminder and multilingual re-invitation for colorectal screening is expected to add 1.5-4.37 percentage points, closing about 69% of the gap.

sources.label: THL Sotkanet: Suolistosyövän seulontaan osallistuneiden osuus kutsutuista, %

facts.indicator: Proportion of invited to colorectal cancer screening who attended, %
facts.proposed_action: Reminder and multilingual re-invitation for colorectal screening
facts.nature_of_estimate: expected gain taken from Finnish trial evidence, a scenario

claims.text: First step for every county: Add first contact, referral, diagnosis and first treatment dates, plus entry route, to the national cancer quality register and publish county-level medians quarterly.

facts.recommended_first_step_for_every_county: Add first contact, referral, diagnosis and first treatment dates, plus entry route, to the national cancer quality register and publish county-level medians quarterly.
facts.reason: The Goal 3 indicator "treatment within target times" cannot be computed from open data today. Without it no county can see where its own pathway loses time.

output.settings: default (stored in app.json, with sensitivity ranges)

output.note: Screening actions are scored on participation, not mortality; they are not part of the budgeted mortality portfolio.

output.title: Standardised, timed cancer pathways with a fast-track referral
output.action: Adopt national cancer-specific pathways with maximum times per step and a single fast-track referral from primary care, following the Danish and Swedish model.
output.accountable_owner: Wellbeing services county, coordinated nationally by FICAN
output.mechanism: One referral criterion and booked slots replace sequential queues between primary care, imaging and the specialist clinic.

indicator_to_monitor.title: Patients waiting over 6 months during the year for access to specialised health care per 10 000 inhabitants

output.what_remains_unknown: Danish evidence is before/after without a control group. Patients left outside the pathway waited 4 days longer, so coverage must be monitored.

evidence.finding: After Denmark introduced standardised cancer patient pathways, the median diagnostic interval was 17 days shorter in 2010 than in 2004/05; patients not referred to a pathway waited 4 days longer.
evidence.unit: days, median diagnostic interval after vs before
evidence.citation: Jensen H, Tørring ML, Olesen F, Overgaard J, Fenger-Grøn M, Vedsted P. Diagnostic intervals before and after implementation of cancer patient pathways. BMC Cancer 2015;15:308.
evidence.caveat: Before/after without control group; two-tier risk for patients outside the pathway.

evidence.finding: Danish patients referred through a cancer patient pathway had a 1-year excess hazard ratio of 0.86 (0.73-1.01) vs patients not referred; 3-year relative survival rose from 45% to 54% across the implementation period.
evidence.unit: 1-year excess hazard ratio, pathway-referred vs not
evidence.citation: Jensen H, Tørring ML, Vedsted P. Prognostic consequences of implementing cancer patient pathways in Denmark. BMC Cancer 2017;17:627.
evidence.caveat: Interval includes 1; lead-time and secular-trend bias acknowledged by authors.

evidence.finding: Currently no unified national system guides disease-specific care guidelines or the implementation and monitoring of care pathways; existing guidelines, pathways, targets and indicators are not coordinated nationally, which perpetuates regional inequalities in access to and effectiveness of cancer care.

heading.fi: Toimenpide 3.1.2 Laaditaan syöpäkohtaiset hoitoketjukuvaukset, ja niiden pohjalta sovelletut alueelliset hoitoketjut, sekä mekanismi niiden ylläpitoon ja hallintaan

primaryMeasure.title_en: Write cancer-specific care pathway descriptions, regional pathways adapted from them, and a mechanism to maintain and manage them

keyText.fi: Kansalliset hoitoketjut kuvataan hyödyntäen pohjoismaissa kehitettyjä malleja.
keyText.en: National pathways are described using models developed in the Nordic countries (the text names Denmark's Kræftpakkeforløb, Sweden's SVF and Norway's Pakkeforløp).

keyText.fi: Ketjuissa määritellään ja sovitaan mm. työnjaosta eri toimijoiden välillä, tavoitelluista hoitoonpääsyajoista, keskeisistä laatu- ja vaikuttavuusindikaattoreista sekä kirjaamis- ja koodistokäytännöistä.
keyText.en: The pathways define and agree, among other things, the division of work, target access times, the key quality and effectiveness indicators, and recording and coding practices.

owner.fi: Vastuutaho: FICAN (kansallinen koordinaatio, prosessin hallinta ja tukitoiminnot sekä alueellinen käyttöönotto ja seuranta) yhteistyössä kansallisten monialaisten syöpäryhmien kanssa (hoitoketjujen sisällöt), hyvinvointialueet ja HUS (hoitoketjujen toteutus).

primaryMeasure.owner_en: FICAN with the national multidisciplinary cancer groups (pathway content); wellbeing services counties and HUS (implementation)

resource.fi: Resurssi: Toteutetaan osana toimenpiteessä 3.1.1 kuvattua kokonaisresursointia.

schedule.fi: 2026–2028: Kansalliset hoitoketjukuvaukset tehty viidestä syövästä ja syöpäkohtaiset hoitoonpääsyajat on määritetty.
schedule.en: 2026–2028: national pathway descriptions done for five cancers and cancer-specific access times defined.

schedule.fi: 2029–2031: Kansalliset hoitoketjukuvaukset laadittu kaikista merkittävistä syövistä/ syöpäryhmistä.

metrics.fi: Mittari: Potilaat pääsevät hoitoon tavoiteaikojen puitteissa.
metrics.en: Patients access treatment within the target times.

relatedMeasures.title_en: Support a smooth transfer to specialised care by defining standardised referral criteria within national care pathways, so that patients with possible cancer symptoms who meet them are sent quickly to the diagnostic tests they need
relatedMeasures.owner_en: FICAN (coordination and roll-out) with the national multiprofessional cancer groups

relatedMeasures.title_en: Define national quality and effectiveness targets and monitoring indicators so that care pathways can be monitored
relatedMeasures.owner_en: FICAN with the national cancer diagnostics and treatment steering group (shared indicators) and the national multidisciplinary cancer groups (cancer-specific targets and indicators); THL (methodological support)

output.reading_en: 3.1.2 writes cancer-specific national pathways on the Danish, Swedish and Norwegian models with target access times; 2.5.2 adds standardised referral criteria from primary care. Together they are this action.
output.gap_en: SAMA's action text says 'maximum times per step'. The roadmap leaves the values to 3.1.2 (five cancers in 2026–2028); SAMA proposes no values of its own.

thresholdRelabels.location: src/recommend.mjs INTERVENTIONS timed-pathways.action ('maximum times per step')
thresholdRelabels.relabel_en: Maximum times per step are placeholders until roadmap measure 3.1.2 defines cancer-specific access times (five cancers, 2026–2028) and 3.1.4 sets the targets and indicators. SAMA proposes no values.

roadmap.title: Kansallinen syöpästrategia 2026–2035 – Toimeenpanon tiekartta vuosille 2026–2031
roadmap.titleEn: Finland's National Cancer Strategy 2026–2035: Roadmap for implementation for 2026–2031
roadmap.note: Finnish quotes are verbatim from the roadmap (see manifest quoteRule). English text is the SAMA team's own reading and translation, not an official one. A mapping says which roadmap measure an action would serve; it is not an endorsement by the roadmap's authors.

output.title: Reminder and multilingual re-invitation for colorectal screening
output.action: Send a second kit with plain-language, multilingual instructions to non-responders; measure the gain as a stepped pilot.
output.mechanism: Transfers the reminder protocol proven in Finnish cervical screening.

indicator_to_monitor.title: Proportion of invited to colorectal cancer screening who attended, %

output.what_remains_unknown: No Finnish effect size exists for colorectal screening; the gain is borrowed from cervical screening and must be measured.

evidence.finding: In Finland, reminder letters raised cervical screening participation from 72.6% to 79.2% and adding self-sampling raised it to 82.2%.
evidence.unit: percentage points (72.6% to 79.2% with reminder letters, 82.2% adding self-sampling)
evidence.citation: Virtanen A, et al. Improving cervical cancer screening attendance in Finland. Int J Cancer 2015;136(6):E677-E684.

evidence.finding: All cancer screening programmes achieve an 80% participation rate in each wellbeing services county; at least 70% of cancers are diagnosed at stages I to II.
evidence.unit: % participation target in every wellbeing services county

output.statement: Serves roadmap measure 1.3.1; the roadmap does not name this specific action.

heading.fi: Toimenpide 1.3.1 Parannetaan eri kieliryhmiin kuuluvien väestöryhmien osallistumista rokotuksiin sekä syöpäseulontoihin kohdennetun ja yhteisölähtöisen viestinnän avulla

primaryMeasure.title_en: Raise vaccination and cancer screening participation in different language groups through targeted, community-based communication

keyText.fi: monikielistä, selkokielistä ja kulttuurisesti sensitiivistä materiaalia
keyText.en: multilingual, plain-language and culturally sensitive material

owner.fi: Vastuutaho: Hyvinvointialueet, Helsingin kaupunki ja HUS, järjestöt, Syöpärekisteri, THL.

primaryMeasure.owner_en: Wellbeing services counties, City of Helsinki and HUS, NGOs, Cancer Registry, THL

schedule.fi: 2026–2028: Kohderyhmän kanssa jo yhteiskehitettyjä viestintämateriaaleja seulonnoista ja rokotuksista hyödynnetään ja uutta materiaalia tuotetaan tarpeen mukaan eri kielillä.
2029–2031: Terveydenedistämistyö julkisen sektorin ja eri kieli- ja kulttuurivähemmistöjä edustavien järjestöjen kanssa on vakiintunutta.

metrics.fi: Mittari: Seulontoihin osallistumisasteen parantuminen siten, että äidinkielenään muita kieliä kuin suomea ja ruotsia puhuvan väestön osallistumisaste saavuttaa suomen- ja ruotsinkielisen väestön tason.
metrics.en: Screening participation of people whose mother tongue is not Finnish or Swedish reaches the level of the Finnish- and Swedish-speaking population.

relatedMeasures.title_en: Use the screening programmes' quality manuals throughout service procurement and steering
relatedMeasures.owner_en: National cancer screening steering group, screening programme expert groups, wellbeing services counties and the City of Helsinki, Cancer Registry

relatedMeasures.title_en: Secure funding for pilot studies run within the screening programme
relatedMeasures.owner_en: Finnish Cancer Registry, wellbeing services counties, HUS and the City of Helsinki

output.reading_en: Multilingual, plain-language re-invitations are what 1.3.1 funds, and its metric is that participation of people whose mother tongue is not Finnish or Swedish reaches the level of Finnish and Swedish speakers. The stepped pilot fits 2.4.4.
output.gap_en: The roadmap names no colorectal reminder protocol and no second kit.
noRoadmapMeasureFor: a second colorectal screening kit for non-responders

roadmap.title: Kansallinen syöpästrategia 2026–2035 – Toimeenpanon tiekartta vuosille 2026–2031
roadmap.titleEn: Finland's National Cancer Strategy 2026–2035: Roadmap for implementation for 2026–2031
roadmap.note: Finnish quotes are verbatim from the roadmap (see manifest quoteRule). English text is the SAMA team's own reading and translation, not an official one. A mapping says which roadmap measure an action would serve; it is not an endorsement by the roadmap's authors.

output.title: Record four pathway timestamps for every cancer patient
output.action: Add first contact, referral, diagnosis and first treatment dates, plus entry route, to the national cancer quality register and publish county-level medians quarterly.
output.accountable_owner: FICAN with THL and the Finnish Cancer Registry
output.mechanism: The Goal 3 indicator "treatment within target times" cannot be computed from open data today. Without it no county can see where its own pathway loses time.

indicator_to_monitor.key: Share of new cancer cases with all four timestamps recorded
indicator_to_monitor.title: Share of new cancer cases with all four timestamps recorded

output.what_remains_unknown: No health effect is modelled: this is the measurement that makes the other actions accountable.

evidence.finding: National Cancer Strategy 2026-2035, objective 3 'Ensuring equal and effective cancer care': five-year survival of poor-prognosis cancers reaches the Nordic level (lung +14 pp, pancreas +6 pp, liver +14 pp vs the 2023 NORDCAN level; Nordic = mean of Sweden and Norway); cancer mortality decreases by 10% (currently 13,300 deaths per year); patients access treatment within the established target times (THL Ohjaus 21/2016).
evidence.citation: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health / FICAN. National Cancer Strategy 2026-2035. Figure 1 and section 3.

evidence.finding: Currently no unified national system guides disease-specific care guidelines or the implementation and monitoring of care pathways; existing guidelines, pathways, targets and indicators are not coordinated nationally, which perpetuates regional inequalities in access to and effectiveness of cancer care.

output.statement: Serves roadmap measure 3.2.1; the roadmap does not name this specific action.

heading.fi: Toimenpide 3.2.1 Luodaan lainsäädännöllinen pohja THL:n Syöpärekisterin yhteyteen perustettavalle syövän hoidon laaturekisterille

primaryMeasure.title_en: Create the legal basis for a cancer care quality register at THL's Cancer Registry

keyText.fi: Perustetaan THL:n Syöpärekisterin yhteyteen kansallinen syövän hoidon laaturekisteri.
keyText.en: A national cancer care quality register is set up at THL's Cancer Registry.

owner.fi: Vastuutaho: STM (asetusmuutos), THL/Suomen Syöpärekisteri (syövän laaturekisterin perustaminen ja ylläpito), FICAN.

primaryMeasure.owner_en: STM (decree change), THL / Finnish Cancer Registry (establishes and maintains the register), FICAN

schedule.fi: 2029–2031: Syövän laaturekisteri tuottaa vähintään viiden eri syövän vuosittaiset raportit

metrics.fi: Mittari: Laaturekisterin tietopohja (ml. levinneisyystieto) mahdollistaa laadun ja vaikuttavuuden luotettavan arvioinnin ja vertailun (tietopohjan kattavuus 90 %); Kliinisten syöpäilmoitusten määrä (tavoitteena 90 % tapauksista automatisoidusti vuoteen 2030 mennessä).
metrics.en: Register data (including stage) allow reliable assessment and comparison of quality and effectiveness (coverage 90%); clinical cancer notifications (target: 90% of cases automated by 2030).

relatedMeasures.title_en: Write cancer-specific care pathway descriptions, regional pathways adapted from them, and a mechanism to maintain and manage them
relatedMeasures.owner_en: FICAN with the national multidisciplinary cancer groups (pathway content); wellbeing services counties and HUS (implementation)

relatedMeasures.title_en: Define national quality and effectiveness targets and monitoring indicators so that care pathways can be monitored
relatedMeasures.owner_en: FICAN with the national cancer diagnostics and treatment steering group (shared indicators) and the national multidisciplinary cancer groups (cancer-specific targets and indicators); THL (methodological support)

relatedMeasures.title_en: Define and start peer-development processes that compare and review quality register data systematically
relatedMeasures.owner_en: FICAN (organises peer review and peer development), THL

relatedMeasures.title_en: Produce reliable evidence from the national cancer data resource for research, treatment effectiveness and real-time management
relatedMeasures.owner_en: FHDS-Tieto, authorities, universities; also wellbeing services counties and HUS

output.reading_en: Recording first contact, referral, diagnosis and treatment dates in the national quality register is what the 3.1.2 metric 'patients access treatment within the target times' needs before it can be computed, and what 3.2.2's county benchmarking and 4.1.3's live views of treatment start delays would read.
output.gap_en: The roadmap does not list these four dates, the entry route, or quarterly county medians. Which timestamps the register holds is left to 3.1.4 and the register work in 3.2.1.
noRoadmapMeasureFor: quarterly publication of county-level medians (3.2.2 has annual peer reviews and publicly reported regional indicators, without a frequency for publication)

thresholdRelabels.location: eventlog/aggregate.py aggregate(): thresholds=dict(primary_care=90, diagnostic=60, treatment=30, total=180); written to data/eventlog/county-intervals.json as threshold_days and share_within
thresholdRelabels.relabel_en: Placeholder threshold, not a national target time. Cancer-specific access times are to be defined under roadmap measure 3.1.2 (five cancers, 2026–2028, p. 57), and quality targets and indicators under 3.1.4 (at least the five largest cancer groups, 2026–2028, p. 58). Replace these values when they are published.

thresholdRelabels.location: src/analysis.mjs goal3 indicator 'treatment-within-target' and web/app.mjs 'Treatment within target times: not publicly measurable'
thresholdRelabels.relabel_en: The target times themselves are not yet defined nationally. Roadmap measure 3.1.2 schedules cancer-specific access times for five cancers in 2026–2028, and its metric is that patients access treatment within the target times.

quotes.fi: Mittari: Potilaat pääsevät hoitoon tavoiteaikojen puitteissa.
2026–2028: Kansalliset hoitoketjukuvaukset tehty viidestä syövästä ja syöpäkohtaiset hoitoonpääsyajat on määritetty.

actions.action: Proposed: Adopt national cancer-specific pathways with maximum times per step and a single fast-track referral from primary care, following the Danish and Swedish model.
actions.rationale: The portfolio picks timed-pathways for HVA16 at EUR 284,211 a year, with a model scenario of 9.4 deaths postponed per year (range 1.4-18.9) and 94% of sensitivity runs keeping it, while the brief shows referral into specialist care is the earliest stage where the county is clearly worse than the country, with referrals processed within 3 days at 70.8% against 76.8% nationally.
actions.owner_role: Accountable owner: Wellbeing services county, coordinated nationally by FICAN.
actions.indicator: Indicator to monitor: Patients waiting over 6 months during the year for access to specialised health care per 10 000 inhabitants.

actions.action: Proposed: Send a second kit with plain-language, multilingual instructions to non-responders; measure the gain as a stepped pilot.
actions.rationale: The brief shows colorectal screening participation in HVA16 is 75.6% against the 80% target, and the portfolio lists screening-reminders as the county screening action with an expected gain of 1.5-4.37 percentage points, closing about 69% of the gap.
actions.owner_role: Accountable owner: Wellbeing services county screening unit.
actions.indicator: Indicator to monitor: Proportion of invited to colorectal cancer screening who attended, %.

actions.action: Proposed: Add first contact, referral, diagnosis and first treatment dates, plus entry route, to the national cancer quality register and publish county-level medians quarterly.
actions.rationale: The brief states this is the first step for every county because the Goal 3 indicator treatment within target times cannot be checked from open data, and time from referral to diagnosis and from diagnosis to first treatment is not published by county for any cancer.
actions.owner_role: Accountable owner: FICAN with THL and the Finnish Cancer Registry.
actions.indicator: Indicator to monitor: Share of new cancer cases with all four timestamps recorded.

actions.title: Standardised, timed cancer pathways with a fast-track referral

roadmap.title_en: Write cancer-specific care pathway descriptions, regional pathways adapted from them, and a mechanism to maintain and manage them

sentences.text: Proposed: Adopt national cancer-specific pathways with maximum times per step and a single fast-track referral from primary care, following the Danish and Swedish model.

The portfolio picks timed-pathways for HVA16 at EUR 284,211 a year, with a model scenario of 9.4 deaths postponed per year (range 1.4-18.9) and 94% of sensitivity runs keeping it, while the brief shows referral into specialist care is the earliest stage where the county is clearly worse than the country, with referrals processed within 3 days at 70.8% against 76.8% nationally.
Accountable owner: Wellbeing services county, coordinated nationally by FICAN.
Indicator to monitor: Patients waiting over 6 months during the year for access to specialised health care per 10 000 inhabitants.

actions.title: Reminder and multilingual re-invitation for colorectal screening

roadmap.title_en: Raise vaccination and cancer screening participation in different language groups through targeted, community-based communication

sentences.text: Proposed: Send a second kit with plain-language, multilingual instructions to non-responders; measure the gain as a stepped pilot.

The brief shows colorectal screening participation in HVA16 is 75.6% against the 80% target, and the portfolio lists screening-reminders as the county screening action with an expected gain of 1.5-4.37 percentage points, closing about 69% of the gap.
Accountable owner: Wellbeing services county screening unit.
Indicator to monitor: Proportion of invited to colorectal cancer screening who attended, %.

actions.title: Record four pathway timestamps for every cancer patient

roadmap.title_en: Create the legal basis for a cancer care quality register at THL's Cancer Registry

sentences.text: Proposed: Add first contact, referral, diagnosis and first treatment dates, plus entry route, to the national cancer quality register and publish county-level medians quarterly.

The brief states this is the first step for every county because the Goal 3 indicator treatment within target times cannot be checked from open data, and time from referral to diagnosis and from diagnosis to first treatment is not published by county for any cancer.
Accountable owner: FICAN with THL and the Finnish Cancer Registry.
Indicator to monitor: Share of new cancer cases with all four timestamps recorded.

evidenceLimit.text: timed-pathways: Danish evidence is before/after without a control group. Patients left outside the pathway waited 4 days longer, so coverage must be monitored.
